words: بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ
rows.speaker: author

rows.speaker: author

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though Makkah had no date trees, Abraham's prayer for fruits for Hagar and Ishmael was answered by produce brought from surrounding regions.

rows.speaker: some commentators
rows.claim: Some commentators say the prayer was answered through abundant date palms in nearby Ṭāʾif, which had substantial historical and commercial ties with Makkah.
